control_scope.warning: The default lift-name limit 22 is not a standalone upper bound for every recursion seal. The succinct check_code closure ignores its po2 argument; code-root constraints may restrict feasibility, which is not proved here.

control_tree.digest_encoding: 8 canonical Montgomery u32 words, little-endian bytes
control_tree.leaf_encoding: control ID itself; no additional leaf hash
control_tree.node_hash: Poseidon2 unpadded overwrite sponge on exactly 16 field elements

fri_schedule_scope: Public arithmetic for each explicit parser po2 value, not a claim that every value admits a valid seal. No FRI folding-round count is substituted for the full IOR round count.

fri_transcript_audit.build_precondition: circuit_debug disabled; this module does not attest build features.

grinding.limits: Does not exclude offline transcript search, wrapper gates, the separate rv32im protocol, or generated recursive verifier behavior. PoN lottery supplies no credit here.
grinding.method: Manual control-flow review tied to exact six-file source hashes.

merkle_binding.cap: Read fixed cap in order, validate digests, reconstruct root; only root is mixed.
merkle_binding.encoding: Reduced Montgomery u32 words; digest has eight words; widths are typed externally.
merkle_binding.final_polynomial_layout: component-major: coefficient i component j is final[j*d_final+i].
merkle_binding.fri_leaf_layout: component-major: element i component j is data[j*16+i].
merkle_binding.leaf_length: Trusted taps/CHECK_SIZE/FRI constants set exact consumed field-word counts.
merkle_binding.leaf_position: idx<row_size; idx+row_size and low bits determine ordered hash_pair path.
merkle_binding.tree_depth: Derived from committed raw po2 and fixed circuit; consume L-cap_depth siblings.
merkle_binding.u_coefficients_layout: Each Fp4 coefficient has four consecutive base words.

qrom_interface_obligations: Bind vector widths, lengths, heights, field encodings and phase/circuit context throughout extraction.
Instantiate the selected theorem's quantum commitment-extraction property for the cap-Merkle construction.
Account for unpadded hashing and cross-length/type aliases; parser typing is not an arbitrary-length CRH proof.
Prove the required joint quantum oracle model for commitment hashing and stateful RNG sharing Poseidon2.
Match actual commit/challenge order, raw po2, sampling, statement adaptivity and build features to the theorem.
Prove generated recursive verifiers implement this relation for all allowed control programs.
Instantiate RBR/state-restoration and circuit/proximity bounds including exceptional DEEP points.
Bound lifetime queries across every use and attempt, with compiler losses; RNG call counts are not that budget.

rng.bit_rule: Always draw four; first nonzero as_u32 or zero; mask low bits.
rng.commit_rule: If pool_used!=0 permute and reset; add 8 raw digest cells; permute.

derived_rng_cost.count_kind: Source-level RNG call schedule, not a QROM query budget.

rng.extension_rule: Four consecutive base squeezes in the fixed Fp4 basis.

ideal_sampler_deviation.assumption: Conditionally independent uniform Fp draws and k<=27.
